indications: Anastrozole is an aromatase inhibitor indicated for: Adjuvant treatment of postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive early breast cancer ( 1.1 ) First-line treatment of postmenopausal women with hormone receptor-positive or hormone receptor unknown locally advanced or metastatic breast cancer ( 1.2 ) Treatment of advanced breast cancer in postmenopausal women with disease progression following tamoxifen therapy. Patients with ER-negative disease and patients who did not respond to previous tamoxifen therapy rarely responded to Anastrozole  ( 1.3 )
contraindications: One 1 mg tablet taken once daily ( 2.1 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
Anastrozole Tablets, USP 1 mg are white, circular, biconvex tablets, debossed with ‘YL’ on one side, and ‘111’ on the other side.
                  Anastrozole Tablets, USP 1 mg are supplied in bottles of 30 tablets (NDC 68071-3999-3).
adverseReactions: Patients with demonstrated hypersensitivity to anastrozole tablets or any excipient ( 4 )
